summary.headline: Jubilant Ingrevia Q2 FY27 revenue rose 24% YoY to INR1,394 crore and EBITDA 51% to INR221 crore; FY27 guidance reiterated, nearer upper end.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue hit an all-time high of INR1,394 crore (up 24% YoY) and EBITDA rose 51% YoY to INR221 crore, the highest in three years, with PAT up 60% YoY to INR111 crore. H1 revenue grew 25% and EBITDA 44% YoY. Management reiterated its FY27 guidance of INR750-800 crore (EBITDA basis as discussed on the call) and said it expects to land closer to the upper end, helped by a recent European competitor plant closure in acetic anhydride. The company also signed to acquire 40% of Zettaone Technologies for INR189 crore, entering electronics design and manufacturing services. Uncertainty remains on the large innovator CDMO contract, where future volume visibility is still pending.

segments.name: Specialty chemicals (fine chemicals, CDMO, pyridine and picolines)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR560 crore (+16% YoY, +5% QoQ) and EBITDA INR140 crore at 25% margin, driven by pricing in fine chemicals and CDMO; pyridine volumes stable but pricing soft.

segments.name: Nutrition and health solutions
segments.commentary: Revenue INR270 crore (+50% YoY) and EBITDA INR39 crore at 15% margin; vitamin B3 volumes grew double digits in food, cosmetic and animal feed; B3 animal feed pricing softened in recent weeks.

segments.name: Chemical intermediates (acetyls)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR563 crore (+24% YoY) and EBITDA INR64 crore (+26% YoY); acetic anhydride pricing up double digits YoY with share gains in Europe; ethyl acetate realisations improved.

segments.name: Personal care
segments.commentary: Management said personal care products now make up about 7% of the overall portfolio, with a target of reaching double digits within a few quarters.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance of INR750-800 crore reiterated; management expects to be closer to the upper end given H1 performance (as stated on the call).
Growth expected across all three business segments in FY27.
Specialty chemicals aspiration of 20-25% YoY growth on a multi-year CAGR basis; not expected every quarter.
Roughly one-third of the INR1,500 crore-plus peak revenue from confirmed non-large-contract opportunities expected in FY27; full potential with the large contract close to INR2,000 crore.
Capex of at least INR400-500 crore every year on a multi-year average; Gajraula multipurpose plant ready in the next few months.

Europe plant closure uplift expected from early calendar 2027; management aims to double Europe acetic anhydride share (currently high teens to about 20%) over the next couple of years, with bigger benefit hoped in FY28.
risks_watch: Large innovator CDMO contract: future volume visibility and take-or-pay position still undisclosed; innovator has converted its revolving credit facility to secured with subsidiary guarantees and asset pledges. Management says risk is fully protected under the agreement.
Europe plant closure timing and duration not confirmed by the competitor; uplift timing uncertain.
Vitamin B3 pricing softness in animal feed may linger into Q3; base pyridine pricing pressure.
Lumpy specialty chemicals revenue; H1 EBITDA growth (44% group) versus specialty chemicals 20-25% aspiration.
Zettaone acquisition (40% stake, INR189 crore): shareholder agreement yet to be concluded; accounting treatment (associate) not confirmed.
Input and utility cost pressures from elevated crude prices and geopolitical uncertainty.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the financial run-rate and guidance, with reiterated FY27 guidance and an expectation of landing near the upper end. Evasive on the large innovator CDMO contract, repeatedly deferring details to 'within a few weeks' and declining to comment on the customer's finances.
key_quotes: Revenue reached an all-time high of INR1,394 crore, up 24% year-on-year, supported by stronger realizations and stable volumes.

I think we are sticking to our guidance. In fact, we think we should given the strong performance in the first half of the year, we should hopefully be closer to the upper end of the guidance we have given for the year.

As and when we start serving some of the big orders, it shows a kicker and, and step change in the trajectory, and in some quarters it may be even lower, like we have seen in couple of quarters back as well.
We will be investing at least INR400 crore to INR500 crore every year as we announced a couple of years back in our investor presentation also.

financial_highlights.change: +51% YoY; highest in last three years

qa_highlights.question: Given the European closure in mid-September and no large CDMO contract contribution in H2 guidance, how should FY27 guidance of INR750-800 crore be viewed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is sticking to guidance and expects to land closer to the upper end given strong H1; Europe uplift expected only from early calendar 2027, with a bigger blip hoped for in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Has there been further visibility on large CDMO contract orders or take-or-pay commitments?
qa_highlights.answer: The first lot has been delivered as committed; for future volumes several scenarios are being discussed and the company is very close to concluding the way forward, with visibility hoped for within a few weeks. No comment on the customer's finances.

qa_highlights.question: How large is the Europe acetic anhydride opportunity?
qa_highlights.answer: Current share is high teens to about 20%; aspiration is to double it over the next couple of years, provided the closed plants remain shut, which the competitor has yet to confirm. Quantum still being assessed.

qa_highlights.question: How much revenue from the rest of the order book will be booked in FY27 and FY28 excluding the large contract?
qa_highlights.answer: Peak potential of INR1,500 crore-plus from confirmed non-large-contract opportunities, with at least one-third in FY27; full potential including the large contract is close to INR2,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Zettaone trajectory and will it be accounted as an associate; what should full-year capex be after about INR120 crore in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Zettaone expected to grow at least 60-70% this year; the market is growing 35-40% annually. Capex maintained at INR400-500 crore per year on a multi-year average, with Gajraula ready in the next few months; no specific full-year figure given.

qa_highlights.question: Why did H1 specialty chemicals EBITDA grow only modestly, and is the large order EBITDA back-ended?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the 20-25% growth aspiration is a multi-year CAGR, not quarterly; projects are lumpy with a lag between plant construction and revenue; specialty chemicals plus nutrition EBITDA has roughly doubled in three years.

qa_highlights.question: Is there pricing pressure or base rundown that will offset new contracts?
qa_highlights.answer: Pressure on base pyridine and vitamin B3 is normal; most segments are holding prices, with B3 declines in recent weeks possibly lingering into Q3.

capex_capacity: Capex to be at least INR400-500 crore every year on a multi-year average, as announced in the investor presentation a couple of years back.
Management said it creates about two new, ideally multipurpose, plants every year; Gajraula multipurpose plant to be ready in the next few months.
Company is conceptualising a couple of other investments; specific capex to be announced once board approval is received.
Management said investments made in the last three to three-and-a-half years should reach average utilisation of 70%-plus by end of FY27, requiring new plants for incremental growth.
Analyst asked about H1 capex of about INR120 crore; the answer given was the INR400-500 crore annual range without a specific FY27 figure.
New R&D and cleanroom facility in Greater Noida is upcoming to support semiconductor opportunities; Zettaone is establishing a new manufacturing facility near Bangalore.
demand_pricing: Specialty chemicals: fine chemicals and CDMO volumes grew healthily; pricing improved in value-added fine chemicals and CDMO, with diketene portfolio showing particularly strong momentum; pyridine and picolines volumes stable but pricing soft.

Nutrition: vitamin B3 volumes grew double digits YoY and QoQ in food and cosmetic applications; B3 animal feed volumes grew double digits but pricing marginally soft and fell in recent weeks; premix pricing improved; choline stable domestically with sequential volume improvement in Europe.
Chemical intermediates: acetic anhydride saw strong double-digit YoY pricing improvement and share gains in Europe; ethyl acetate realisations improved YoY and QoQ on elevated input costs.
Personal care now about 7% of portfolio; management targets double digits within next few quarters. Strong volume growth in personal care with new customers seeking outsourcing.

Pipeline: 25-plus confirmed molecules; non-large-contract confirmed opportunities have peak potential of INR1,500 crore-plus, with about one-third expected in FY27; semiconductor funnel up nearly 30% in recent months. Management says most segments are holding prices, with pressure on base pyridine and vitamin B3 possibly lingering into Q3.
